claims.statement: Verified fact: Poland's regulator describes a Guarantee of Origin as the sole document proving to the final customer that a specified amount of energy was produced from renewable sources.
Verified fact: Polish Guarantees of Origin are electronic, individually numbered, generally valid for 12 months, issued to 1 MWh precision, and cancellation is recorded in the registry.
Hypothesis (unvalidated): a material subset of suppliers and brokers need a contract-and-meter allocation layer outside the official registry and will pay recurring portfolio fees.

contrary_evidence: The official Polish registry launched bulk transaction handling and a buy/sell bulletin board in 2026, so it may absorb more workflow over time: https://rgp.tge.pl/

Registry users can already receive, transfer, and cancel GOs under standardized terms, making this an internal-control layer rather than a replacement network: https://www.aib-net.org/standard-terms-and-conditions

economics.acquisition_route: Start with one broker or supplier that manages many end-customer allocations, using a read-only reconciliation of an already closed period.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated scenario: 10 portfolios at PLN 5,000 MRR in year 2, 35 at PLN 8,000 MRR in year 4, and 60 at PLN 9,000 MRR in year 6 imply PLN 6.48m ARR before volume fees. At 25% owner earnings and a 3-4x ARR value with 65% ownership, the founder could cross PLN 5m in years 5-7; no demonstrated allocation error or labor saving in three pilots invalidates the wedge.
economics.founder_time: 3-4 hours/day for a single-energy-carrier Polish wedge; do not pursue cross-border and multi-carrier support before repeat revenue.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 80-90% if registry ingestion is export/API based; advisory work and manual registry operations are separately priced.
economics.payback: Unvalidated customer hypothesis: avoiding one shortfall, duplicate allocation, or expired certificate plus faster customer evidence repays several months; historical replay must establish value.
economics.pricing: Unvalidated estimate: PLN 2,000-10,000 per portfolio per month plus PLN 0.01-0.05 per MWh allocated or cancelled.
economics.retention_or_repeat: Energy delivery, certificate acquisition, allocation, expiry, and cancellation recur; contract and beneficiary mappings are sticky.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: allocation histories and exception rules form a defensible operational graph; anonymized timing benchmarks improve procurement and expiry controls
fingerprint.customer: Polish energy suppliers, GO brokers, renewable generators managing customer allocations, and multi-site corporate electricity buyers
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: energy brokers, sustainability-reporting advisers, PPA consultants, and integrations with billing systems rather than a broad direct-sales motion
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: contract-to-meter allocation engine, expiry and shortfall alerts, registry-export reconciliation, cancellation evidence, and customer claim API; portfolio subscription plus volume
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: supplier, broker, or corporate buyer pays per portfolio month and optionally per MWh allocated when a cancellation packet is issued
fingerprint.problem_trigger: monthly or annual disclosure when purchased certificates, contract promises, meter consumption, expiry, and registry cancellations must agree

founder_fit: Combines renewable-energy context, quantitative allocation, and finance-oriented controls.
Can begin as an export-based audit without regulated trading or certificate custody.
Broker and adviser channels reduce reliance on a public personal brand.
A small Polish vertical is compatible with part-time execution and can later expand across EU registries.
risks: The official registry may be sufficient for many users and may restrict automated access.
Incorrect allocation could support misleading renewable claims.
Large suppliers likely have existing energy-trading and risk-management systems.
Certificate rules and cross-border recognition add legal complexity.

structure.control_point: pre-cancellation allocation of each electronic Guarantee of Origin to a contract, consumption period, and final beneficiary
structure.critical_dependency: authorized access or exports from the Polish registry plus trustworthy contract and meter-consumption data

thesis: Build an internal entitlement subledger for Polish energy sellers, brokers, and multi-site buyers that maps individually numbered Guarantees of Origin to purchase contracts, meters, customer claims, validity dates, transfers, and registry cancellation confirmations. The official registry remains the legal source; this layer controls allocation before cancellation and generates customer-specific evidence after it. The paid event is a reconciled monthly portfolio or completed customer cancellation packet.
title: Guarantee-of-Origin Allocation and Cancellation Subledger
uncertainties: The number of Polish organizations with genuinely complex subledger pain is unknown.
Registry export/API capabilities and automation rights need validation.
It is unclear whether energy suppliers, brokers, or end buyers hold the most urgent budget.
Price sensitivity per MWh and sales-cycle length are untested.
